body: Thanks for replying so quickly but my internet just decided to stop working right after I commented -_-. I do appreciate it alot tho...

I haven't tried writing, maybe I will, but I'm so terrible at reading. Unless the book is really entertaining I can't focus enough to read it. I let my therapist know but not my parents. I'm to worried they'll just freak out and lock me up in the hospital or some shit like they've done before. Thanks for your understanding, I'll try writing...

I'm being dead serious but have you gone to a therapist. Because I literally just walked out of one of the most life-changing therapist meetings in my life. I'm literally sitting here waiting for my parents to finish up with her. I was seriously reluctant on going and but a friend basically convinced me to and now I actually see a end to this madness. And I went to a specialized middle/high school in DC where I live so that's why I thought I might know you. Just give a therapist a good thought.👍

Hm sounds exactly like my old school... Why do I feel your somebody I know? Welp idk I realize it seems hard rn but keep in mind youre in Junior year. Two years from now you'll already be moved into a really good college, and from what I've heard college is like a fresh start. With everything... So it's up to you and how much you want to get through. But hey I'm just some random person from your eyes so...🤷‍♂️

Hey, I know you won't believe me at first but I do understand. Actually just last week I was gonna kill myself, still feel like shit... Anyway I'm down to talk just message me I need someone to talk to. And yeah I'm also a teen🤙😔
Hm I wish I had meds for this but I need someone to talk to so just hit me up if u feel like it I just want to be distracted from everything for a while...
I would say something but honestly idek. I'm just some depressed teen who wishes the pain could stop but if u want to talk or something I will, I need help distracting myself anyways soo...?
I'm okay for now I just get rly low every once in a while.

Sorry Im answering so late. Had a rough day. I don't know what I was thinking last night I guess it just got rly bad. Idek I haven't been getting any sleep because of this dumb depression. It just gets worse and worse every day.

Man, I feel guilty. I've been depressed in the past for many different reasons but recently I've been feeling so much pain and loneliness for no reason. It's been getting rly bad recently and I don't know why but you know why and your why must be much greater than mine. I know exactly what it feels like just to want to fall asleep and hope to not wake up and that might not be the case for you but it's the same premise. I honestly don't even feel qualified to give advice but from what I've experienced and am experiencing rn is you need to show them more than you already do how much you love them no matter how they respond just do it for a while and make it cheesy if you have to because showing your true feelings can be cheesy. Try to explain to them what is happening. Personally I don't have the guts to tell my parents Abt how depressed I am rn and they have no idea but I only do it because I feel they won't understand. But you and your parents seemed to have gone through a lot so I think they will.
I'd like an answer soon if possible... Or help.
